incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on streaming gateway (us-west) for /v1/stream endpoints. 5xx% = 5.8 over 5m. Pager: @ryan (oncall). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-5xx

ryan (oncall): ack — I'm awake, joining triage. starting a quick customer-impact check.

lee (support): CS: multiple customers reported aborted streams and partial transcripts; two customers (paying) on us-west-prod. Tickets created: INC-9921, INC-9922.

ana (sre): typo: sorry, ana (sre) here. looking at gateway logs now. seeing a flurry of "upstream prematurely closed connection" and "client canceled" across multiple upstreams.

maya (eng-runtime): also seeing spike in kv-cache invalidation and continuous-batch timeouts on runtime workers, GPU-pool-2. metrics: token latency up x3 and connection reset rate spiking.

ryan (oncall): initial hypothesis: client cancellations + ingress mux hitting a codepath that returns 502/504 during backpressure. Could be client-sdk spike (mobile v1.3.7). Need to reduce blast radius.

ana (sre): running quick query:
```
k logs ingress-gateway-0 --since=10m | grep -E "upstream .*closed|504|502|client canceled" | tail -n 50
```
found many: "nginx: *12345 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream"

maya (eng-runtime): checked runtime node /var/logs/runner.log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z ERROR rpc: write tcp 10.0.4.22:443: write: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z WARN streaming: incomplete chunked frame, client-cancel spike
```
looks like a mix of client cancels + server-side resets.

ryan (oncall): customer-impact triage: which routes are high p95 errors? josh?

josh (product): most traffic is from chat-complete and assistant-stream. We have PLG customers hitting assistant-stream heavily. Losing streaming degrades UX but we can fallback to paged (non-streaming) with minimal data loss for now.

ryan (oncall): live mitigations (plan A -> B):
1) Flip gateway route fallback to paged for assistant-stream for us-west (config flag) -> reduces streaming fanout.
2) Scale ingress and gateway replicas by +2 immediately.
3) Disable continuous-large batching on GPU-pool-2 to reduce memory pressure.
4) Add temporary ingress timeout increase and retry backoff for upstream.
5) Notify CS to enable degraded-mode communication to customers.

maya (eng-runtime): ready to apply 1 & 3. deploying small change to routing config:
```
# apply fallback config
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: streaming-fallback-config
data:
  assistant-stream: "paged"
EOF
```
I'll roll this to us-west only.

deploy-bot: Triggered deploy streaming-fallback-config -> rollout started to us-west clusters. CI checks passed.

ana (sre): scaling gateway replicas now:
```
kubectl scale deploy ingress-gateway --replicas=5 -n prod-us-west
```
Scaling event in progress.

ryan (oncall): disabling continuous-large batching on GPU-pool-2 (maya take it).

maya (eng-runtime): done. changed batching config on pool-2 -> max_batch_tokens=2048 -> applied.

ryan (oncall): monitoring. also toggled upstream retry backoff to avoid hammering.

(3m later)
ana (sre): early signals: 5xx rate down from 5.8% -> 1.1% in 4m after fallback and scale. connection reset counts down 60%.

lee (support): CS update: customers on affected plans report streams now succeed or get graceful paged fallback. leaving notes on INC-9921/2.

josh (product): nice. we should preserve telemetry to measure quality regression from fallback. create eval job.

ryan (oncall): assigning postmortem: ana + maya to lead for root cause. I'll do incident writeup and customer notif draft. handoff to ana for deeper debug.

ana (sre): taking over. next steps: collect tcpdump from affected runtime, correlate client request IDs from logs, and check mobile sdk release list for bursts from v1.3.7.

maya (eng-runtime): I'll snapshot runtime logs and open a PR for safer continuous batching defaults + add health-checks for chunked-encoding processing.

ryan (oncall): closing pager for now — continued monitoring. leaving channel for async updates. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT TRANSITION: Pager resolved by oncall. Follow-up required: postmortem (assigned), customer communications (assigned). Runbook ref: streaming-5xx > follow steps A-B.

ana (sre): noted — will post updates in this thread when we have root cause and postmortem draft. :eyes:
